_note:
**The table under the writing**, and the third table in the game. `traversal: "shot"` — the arrow keys aim a cue, space fires, and where you stop is where you are.

**The cup is not on it.** `PLAN-M22.md` decision 9 stands the boss in a sealed cup of rock here; M22.0 measured that and a cup of rock is not sealed — `shot::shoot_with` tests the tile a tick landed on and never the tiles it crossed, and one tick is 18.75 tiles at power ten, so 6,546 of the shots taken from outside a draft cup came to rest inside it through eight tiles of solid rock. No thickness fixes that. So the cup is `the-cup`, a map of its own, and **the only way onto it is the far pocket** — `to`/`at_to` on a `Pocket`, which is what M22.5 built. A hole is how you go into a room.

**Five obstacles down each rail and nothing in the middle**, which is what makes the far pocket a shot rather than a walk: it is at [17, 2], behind the north range, and the drove way up the east rail is the lane that gets a ball up there with speed left. The two gutters at the bottom are the price of missing.

regions.name: The Lower Table
regions._note: **Four of the Wextreen deep, and the commonest of them is the one the board can beat.** `draw_enemy` weights a pool so its easiest member is its commonest and its hardest its rarest, so what a region *deals* you is not what it contains — and `every_region_has_a_fight_you_can_win_and_every_boss_can_be_beaten` asks about the commonest. Measured against `common::geared_from`: Backsight is a win at 39 seconds and the other three are defeats at 20.4, 31.2 and 17.8. That is the deep's own shape — mostly survivable with rare lethal draws — and it is why Chainman is not here: it is rated *below* Backsight at 1624 and kills that board anyway, so it would have been the commonest draw and a wall. **A rating predicts nothing about whether a fight is winnable.**

places.name: the way back up the lip
the far pocket
places.shut: A hole in the rock at the top of the range, and the only thing anybody has ever seen come out of it is air.

places.name: the left gutter
places.shut: The floor goes away under the rail. Eleven years of things that came down this side are somewhere under it.

places.name: the right gutter
places.shut: Its twin, and no deeper. Whoever cut the second one had already cut the first.

places.name: the standing stone
places.shut: A stone stood on end in the middle of the floor, and the floor round it is worn in a ring.

places.name: the left stone
places.shut: A second one, off the line of the first, and the ring round it is the same depth.

places.name: the right stone
places.shut: A third. Somebody counted, and then stopped counting.

places.name: the left teeth
places.shut: Split rock, on end, in a line. It is not a wall — it is a thing you go through and are the worse for.

places.name: the right teeth
places.shut: The same split rock down the other rail, and the same going-through.

places.name: the drove way up the rail
places.shut: A cut lane up the east wall, roofed for most of its length. What goes in at the bottom comes out at the top still going.

places.name: the drift under the range
places.shut: Grit banked against the rock, a foot of it. Whatever rolls in stops.

places.name: the drift at the head of the way
places.shut: The same grit at the top of the drove way, and it is what the drove way is for.
